name: Atalanta
identity_summary: Bergamo's club is known for growing its own players at Zingonia rather than buying finished stars.
source_quality_notes: Youth sector at Centro Sportivo Bortolotti, Zingonia, is a long documented investment (atalanta.it / Wikipedia youth sector). Founded 17 Oct 1907. H2/M1/M2 left at 4: attacking reputation is too tied to recent coaches.

name: Bologna
identity_summary: Bologna's civic rossoblu. The city comes first, and the curve shows up for the national fights.
source_quality_notes: S3 to 5. Collective away-restriction and affordability action, not a locked idea.

name: Cagliari
identity_summary: Sardinia's island club, remembered for Gigi Riva and a 1970 title far from the mainland.
source_quality_notes: Founded 30 May 1920. Nickname Isolani and 1969-70 Scudetto with Riva are the documented civic story (Wikipedia / club history). Island geography is identity, not current table position.

name: Como
identity_summary: A small lakeside club from Como, local in scale more than distinctive in culture.
source_quality_notes: Founded 25 May 1907 as Como Foot-Ball Club. Current ownership and league place ignored. No strongly documented ritual or ideology found, so most dimensions stay 4.

name: Fiorentina
identity_summary: Florence's purple club. Civic and stubborn, including when the club sells what the city loved.
source_quality_notes: S3 to 5. Challenge over sales is enacted. Personal abuse is not a vector. Style left light.

name: Frosinone
identity_summary: A provincial Lazio club from a small city, with little documented identity beyond home.
source_quality_notes: Club dates foundation to 5 Mar 1906 (US Frusinate); competitive affiliation often cited as 1928. Recent Serie A promotions ignored as table position. Stay near 4 except small-city locality.

name: Genoa
identity_summary: Italy's oldest football club, a port-city griffin side that still treats history as the point.
source_quality_notes: Oldest existing Italian club, founded 7 Sep 1893 at the British Consulate (genoacfc.it; Musei di Genova constitutive act). Derby della Lanterna with Sampdoria. Early championships are history, not a present winning identity, so H1 stays 4.

name: Inter Milan
identity_summary: Milan's internationalist club, founded to welcome foreigners. A big club, not a one-idea machine.
source_quality_notes: Founded 9 Mar 1908 after a split from Milan over foreign players. Derby della Madonnina. Winning is part of the story, not a Madrid-level minimum. Title drought 2010-2021 keeps H1 at 3. Catenaccio is heritage, not a locked present ideology. Current ownership ignored.

name: Lazio
identity_summary: Rome's other club, defined by the Derby della Capitale more than by a single playing idea.
source_quality_notes: Founded 1900. Derby with Roma is the clear identity marker. Supporter politics are documented in the press but not scored as club philosophy. Stay close to 4 elsewhere.

name: Lecce
identity_summary: A Salento civic club from Lecce, local and proud, without a strongly documented football ideology.
source_quality_notes: Founded 1908 (RSSSF Italy foundation dates). Civic south-east identity is the only safe move off 4. No distinctive ideology sourced.

name: AC Milan
identity_summary: One of Italy's aristocrats, a global Milan brand that expects trophies as the minimum.
source_quality_notes: Founded 1899. Multiple European Cups and a global brand are documented. M1 left at 4: Sacchi-era style is real but not the only enduring idea. Current form ignored.

name: Monza
identity_summary: A small Lombardy club from Monza. Enduring identity is local, not yet distinctive.
source_quality_notes: Founded 1912. Recent ownership and first Serie A years ignored. Little sourced ritual or ideology, so almost all 4s.

name: Parma
identity_summary: An Emilian civic club that rose, went bankrupt, and was rebuilt under the 1913 name.
source_quality_notes: Official history: Verdi FBC / Parma FBC in 1913 (parmacalcio1913.com). 2015 refound kept 1913 in the name. 1990s trophies are an era, not the whole identity, so H1 is 5 for collapse and rebuild, not 1 for glory.

name: Sassuolo
identity_summary: A small-town Neroverdi club that reached the top flight from a ceramic-industry town.
source_quality_notes: Official: affiliated 17 Jul 1920 (sassuolocalcio.it). Small-town distinction is the safe move. M3 at 5 is a light academy/readiness inference, confidence 1. Do not treat late promotion as underdog identity.

name: Torino
identity_summary: Turin's maroon club, still shaped by Grande Torino and the 1949 Superga crash.
source_quality_notes: Official: founded 3 Dec 1906 (torinofc.it). Grande Torino and Superga (4 May 1949) are the club's own history pages. Derby with Juventus. This is the clearest suffering/memory identity in the batch.

name: Udinese
identity_summary: A Friulian provincial club, more a city institution than a club with a famous ideology.
source_quality_notes: Founded 1896 (RSSSF). Pozzo-era trading model is an ownership era, so M3 stays 4. Civic Friuli is the safe move.

name: Venezia
identity_summary: Venice's civic club, local to the lagoon, without a strongly documented football philosophy.
source_quality_notes: Founded 1907 (RSSSF). Recent fashion-kit era ignored as a brand moment, not enduring identity. Stay near 4 except civic Venice.

name: Alaves
identity_summary: A Basque civic club that emptied its stands rather than accept Monday football.
source_quality_notes: S3 to 6. Empty-stand scheduling protest is enacted local defiance. Playing idea left at 4.

name: Athletic Bilbao
identity_summary: Bilbao's Basque-only club: home-grown players, city identity, and a rule that refuses imports.
source_quality_notes: The Athletic Club of Bilbao. Cantera policy since 1911 is documented (club / Wikipedia signing policy). This is the only Athletic slug in the set. Do not invent a second San Mames.

name: Celta Vigo
identity_summary: Vigo's sky-blue Galician club, civic and coastal, without a single locked football ideology.
source_quality_notes: Founded 23 Aug 1923 from the merger of Real Vigo Sporting and Real Fortuna (Wikipedia). Galician civic identity is safe. Current attacking reputation left at 4 as too era-tied.
